about_the_game:
Experience Extreme Off-Road Driving
The Bog Busters demo is your chance to test your skills in extreme off-road driving. It’s not just about speed—it’s about mastering vehicle control, adapting to harsh conditions, and overcoming natural obstacles. Feel the realistic driving physics and prepare for a challenging adventure.

What’s Included in the Demo?

  • One Playable Region – Test your skills in a rugged off-road environment with mud traps, slippery rocks, deep water crossings, and steep inclines.
  • Dynamic Weather – Experience how rain turns roads into muddy swamps and fog reduces visibility, making navigation even more difficult.
  • Vehicle Control & Adaptation – Learn to navigate difficult routes with precise controls and realistic physics that account for tire grip and vehicle weight.
  • First-Person & Third-Person Views – Switch between perspectives to find the best way to navigate and control your vehicle.

What’s Not Included in the Demo?

  • Vehicle Customization & Upgrades – The full version will allow modifications to suspension, tires, engines, and other vehicle components.
  • Survival Mechanics – Future updates will introduce hunting, crafting, resource gathering, and interaction with the environment.
  • Expanded Open World – The final game will feature multiple locations, each with unique challenges and terrain.

This demo is designed to introduce you to the core mechanics of Bog Busters and immerse you in the thrill of off-road driving. Take on the challenge, master your vehicle, and get ready for the full version!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or AMD equivalent 4 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or AMD equivalent 4 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Master extreme terrain, adapt to unpredictable weather, and push your survival skills to the limit. Navigate challenging landscapes, upgrade your vehicle (customization coming soon), and explore a dynamic world. Will you conquer the wilderness or be consumed by it?
